def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)

    defaults = {
        "count_orders": 0,
        "count_items": 0,
        "count_sellers": 0,
        "total_price": 0.0,
        "total_freight": 0.0,
        "avg_price": 0.0,
        "avg_freight": 0.0,
        "std_price": 0.0,
        "std_freight": 0.0,
        "min_price": 0.0,
        "max_price": 0.0,
        "days_since_first": 0.0,
        "days_since_last": 0.0,
        "avg_items_per_order": 0.0,
        "has_sales": 0,
        "trend_30_90": 0.0,
    }
    for k, v in defaults.items():
        features[k] = v

    for h in (30, 90):
        features[f"orders_last_{h}"] = 0
        features[f"items_last_{h}"] = 0

    features["review_count"] = 0
    features["avg_review_score"] = 0.0
    features["avg_days_to_review"] = 0.0
    features["payment_count"] = 0
    features["total_payment_value"] = 0.0
    features["avg_installments"] = 0.0

    payment_types = payments["payment_type"].unique() if "payment_type" in payments.columns else []
    for pt in payment_types:
        features[f"payment_type_{pt}"] = 0

    # --- Покупки: используем ts (момент покупки заказа), только события строго до seed_time ---
    if "ts" in items.columns:
        ts_col = "ts"
    else:
        items = items.merge(
            orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]].rename(
                columns={"order_purchase_timestamp": "ts"}
            ),
            on="order_id", how="left"
        )
        ts_col = "ts"

    items_past = items[
        (items[ts_col] < seed_time) &
        (items["product_id"].isin(idx))
    ][["product_id", "order_id", "seller_id", "price", "freight_value", ts_col]].copy()

    if len(items_past) > 0:
        g = items_past.groupby("product_id")

        cnt_orders = g["order_id"].nunique()
        cnt_items = g.size()
        cnt_sellers = g["seller_id"].nunique()
        total_price = g["price"].sum()
        total_freight = g["freight_value"].sum()
        avg_price = g["price"].mean()
        avg_freight = g["freight_value"].mean()
        std_price = g["price"].std(ddof=0)
        std_freight = g["freight_value"].std(ddof=0)
        min_price = g["price"].min()
        max_price = g["price"].max()
        first_date = g[ts_col].min()
        last_date = g[ts_col].max()

        def put(series, col):
            series = series.reindex(idx)
            features[col] = features[col].where(series.isna(), series.fillna(features[col]))

        features.loc[:, "has_sales"] = features.index.isin(cnt_orders.index).astype(int)
        put(cnt_orders, "count_orders")
        put(cnt_items, "count_items")
        put(cnt_sellers, "count_sellers")
        put(total_price, "total_price")
        put(total_freight, "total_freight")
        put(avg_price, "avg_price")
        put(avg_freight, "avg_freight")
        put(std_price.fillna(0.0), "std_price")
        put(std_freight.fillna(0.0), "std_freight")
        put(min_price, "min_price")
        put(max_price, "max_price")
        put((seed_time - first_date).dt.days.astype(float), "days_since_first")
        put((seed_time - last_date).dt.days.astype(float), "days_since_last")
        put(cnt_items / cnt_orders, "avg_items_per_order")

        recent_counts = {}
        for h in (30, 90):
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=h)
            recent = items_past[items_past[ts_col] >= cutoff]
            rg = recent.groupby("product_id")
            r_orders = rg["order_id"].nunique()
            r_items = rg.size()
            put(r_orders, f"orders_last_{h}")
            put(r_items, f"items_last_{h}")
            recent_counts[h] = (r_orders, r_items)

        r30 = recent_counts[30][1].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        r90 = recent_counts[90][1].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        features["trend_30_90"] = (r30 * 3 - r90) / (r90 + 1.0)

    # --- Отзывы: только заказы, купленные до seed_time, и только отзывы,
    #     созданные (published) не позже seed_time. Использование только
    #     review_creation_date гарантирует отсутствие утечки из будущего. ---
    mapping = (
        items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        if len(items_past) > 0
        else pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "order_id"])
    )

    if len(mapping) > 0 and len(reviews) > 0 and "review_creation_date" in reviews.columns:
        reviews_past = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
        if len(reviews_past) > 0:
            joined = reviews_past.merge(mapping, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if len(joined) > 0:
                joined["days_to_review"] = (
                    seed_time - joined["review_creation_date"]
                ).dt.days.astype(float)
                rev_agg = joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    review_count=("review_score", "count"),
                    avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
                    avg_days_to_review=("days_to_review", "mean"),
                )
                for col in ["review_count", "avg_review_score", "avg_days_to_review"]:
                    s = rev_agg[col].reindex(idx)
                    features[col] = features[col].where(s.isna(), s)

    # --- Платежи: только платежи по заказам, купленным до seed_time,
    #     и только платежи, зафиксированные до seed_time (если есть ts). ---
    if len(mapping) > 0 and len(payments) > 0:
        if "ts" in payments.columns:
            payments_past = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
        else:
            payments_past = payments
        pay_merged = payments_past.merge(mapping, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if len(pay_merged) > 0:
            pay_agg = pay_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
                payment_count=("payment_value", "size"),
                total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            )
            for col in ["payment_count", "total_payment_value", "avg_installments"]:
                s = pay_agg[col].reindex(idx)
                features[col] = features[col].where(s.isna(), s)

            for pt in payment_types:
                sub = pay_merged[pay_merged["payment_type"] == pt]
                if len(sub) > 0:
                    ptype_count = sub.groupby("product_id").size()
                    col = f"payment_type_{pt}"
                    s = ptype_count.reindex(idx)
                    features[col] = features[col].where(s.isna(), s)

    features = features.reindex(idx)
    features = features.fillna(0).astype(float)
    return features
